name: dotnet-shared
description: For every C# repository: the testing guideline for an AI agent (the order of the tests, what an agent may not do to make them pass, and the efficient-testing rules R-1 to R-7), as a rule; the slice's mutation check (Stryker.NET on the lines the slice changed), as a script in the project's scripts/ folder, with dotnet-stryker pinned in the project's local tool manifest.
